title: story-031's own acceptance criterion instructed the unconditional pooled-custody NatSpec wording, and its review pass caught the defect without amending the shipped text
storyEvidence: story-031 acceptance criterion at 031-*.md:168 INSTRUCTED the unconditional wording; the story's own review pass caught the defect (Issue 1, :421-427) WITHOUT amending the shipped NatSpec.

rescope.applied: 2026-07-30 (remediation pass) - RESCOPE REQUIRED BEFORE PUBLICATION, per the validity check.
rescope.theTrap: story-031's own review Issue 1 (:421-427) frames the gap as a REBASE CARVE-OUT - post-credit shrinkage of balanceOf(streamer), which is a TOKEN-SIDE property. IF THAT FRAMING IS IMPORTED AS THIS FINDING'S SUBSTANCE, F-01-031 BECOMES A WEIRD-TOKEN FINDING AND IS C4-INVALID STANDALONE under the non-standard-ERC20 rule. Without an explicit disclaimer the finding is one careless read away from being dismissed under the very rule the validity check exists to enforce.
rescope.explicitDisclaimer: *** THE REBASE MECHANISM NAMED IN STORY-031 REVIEW ISSUE 1 IS C4-INVALID STANDALONE AND IS NOT THE BASIS OF THIS FINDING. *** Issue 1 is quoted in the report for EVIDENTIARY value only - it proves the story's own review CAUGHT the defect and shipped anyway. It is not the mechanism.
pinnedToTokenIndependentLimbs: LIMB 1 - THE DOCUMENTED-BASIS ERROR. The acceptance criterion at :168 instructed an UNCONDITIONAL claim, attributed to a CONSTRUCTION AT ONE SITE, about a property that is in fact a TWO-SITE CONJUNCTION: the measured-receipt credit in collectNudge AND the per-stream cap in _accrued that bounds each _settle debit. 'By construction at one site' IS NOT WHY THE INVARIANT HOLDS. Present in the shipped text at named lines; observable with no token property whatsoever; the same defect Q-01 (e16a9cac...) carries on the code side.

LIMB 2 - THE PROCESS DEFECT. The story's own review pass caught it and the story shipped UNAMENDED - neither the NatSpec nor the acceptance criterion was corrected. Instructed, then caught, then shipped. That is why this is a Law-2 finding at all, and it is entirely token-independent.
rescope.notTheClaim: This finding does NOT claim 'the invariant can be broken by a rebasing token'. Where post-credit erosion appears in the report text it ILLUSTRATES WHAT THE SINGLE-SITE FRAMING FAILS TO DESCRIBE; it never asserts a reachable exploit.
rescope.recommendationFollows: The remediation is therefore to STATE THE REAL BASIS (credit PLUS the _accrued cap) or add the clamp the text implies - neither of which is a weird-token defence. Scoping the credit site to the direction it actually closes is an optional completeness nicety, NOT the finding.

description: Law-2 mirror of Q-01 (D-26-03). Same underlying text, different channel: this is the FAITHFULNESS finding that the falsely-exhaustive pooled-custody claim was not an implementation slip but was INSTRUCTED by the story, and that the story's own review caught it and shipped anyway.
impact: Documentation accuracy on a load-bearing invariant, traceable to the story process rather than to the implementer. The residual is documentation accuracy.
severityNote: Low. WALK-BACK from the faithfulness agent's `potential-medium` is RECOMMENDED AND APPLIED: that Medium read was predicated on the DoS chain, which is now KILLED (Leg B) and separately carried at Low by L-01 (D-26-01). The Medium premise no longer exists.
law1Override: APPLIED UPSTREAM AND CONFIRMED: story-031's intended mechanism (min(received, amount), snapshot after _settle, revert on zero receipt) is STRICTLY SAFETY-IMPROVING. NO `story-unsafe` flag.
dualRoute: INTENTIONAL per upstream decision 3, NOT a duplicate. Paired with Q-01 (D-26-03). MUST NOT be folded into the QA/gas bundle. Cross-reference both ways.
recommendation: Amend the shipped NatSpec (src/NudgeStreamer.sol:55-62, :250-265) to STATE THE REAL BASIS - the aggregate is sustained by a CONJUNCTION of the measured-receipt credit in collectNudge AND the per-stream cap in _accrued - or add the clamp the current text implies. Do not describe it as established at a single site and do not describe it as holding 'by construction'. Close story-031 review Issue 1 rather than leaving it recorded-but-unactioned. Fix the story's acceptance criterion at :168 so the same wording is not re-instructed. NOTE: do NOT re-express the fix as 'add a rebase carve-out' - that would re-import the C4-invalid limb this finding is explicitly rescoped away from (see rescope).
